policy.notes: This prospective split was frozen after AR4-AR6 implementation. Historical AR4 live runs are reported separately and are not relabeled as held-out results.

report.title: Cart total omits a visible shipping charge
report.description: The displayed total contains only merchandise even though a shipping charge is shown.
report.expected: Shipping is $5.00, so Total should be $15.00.
report.context: Fresh browser storage and an empty cart.

report.title: Repeated add does not increase quantity
report.description: Adding the same product twice appears to leave a single unit in the cart.
report.context: Fresh browser storage and an empty cart.

report.title: Removing Keyboard leaves the wrong cart line
report.description: Removing one product appears to retain it and discard the other product.
report.expected: Only Mouse Pad should remain in the cart.
report.actual: Keyboard remains and Mouse Pad disappears.
report.context: Fresh browser storage and an empty cart.

report.title: Promo completion loses a concurrently added item
report.description: An item added while promo validation is pending disappears when validation completes.
steps: Apply the promo and immediately add Mouse Pad
report.expected: Keyboard and Mouse Pad should both remain after the promo is applied.
report.actual: Mouse Pad disappears when the promo result arrives.
report.context: Fresh browser storage; promo validation is asynchronous.

report.title: Cart badge counts product lines instead of units
report.description: The navigation badge appears to show unique products rather than total quantity.
report.context: Fresh browser storage and an empty cart.

report.title: Free shipping threshold is not reflected in the order summary
report.description: An order at exactly $50 appears to retain a shipping fee in both calculation and display.
report.expected: At a $50 subtotal, Shipping should be $0.00 and Total should be $50.00.
report.actual: Shipping shows $5.00 and the order total includes it.
report.context: Fresh browser storage; free shipping begins at $50.
